A minor '''Incident near Ithor system''' occurred during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. [[Zayne Carrick]] used a debt owned to him by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] commander [[Cassus Fett]] to make Fett simulate a battle with the Republic task force commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]]. However, his true purpose was to capture [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dace Golliard]] of [[the Crucible]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']] and force him to revel the location of [[Osadia]] where Carrick's friend [[Jarael]] was located. Golliard hid his slave ship behind an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], waiting to pick up [[Escape pod/Legends|lifepods]] and ships left after the battle. However, after attracting the Republic forces into the area, the Mandalorian fleet avoided the battle, jumping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and allowing Carrick to communicate with Karath, who then proceeded to capture the [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']] and its captain.
